findings.body: This part stops at adding the active-actual-month lookup; it does not yet implement Done-when 1's trigger, month/YTD option policy, ClarificationNeeded response, continuation handling, or answer period control. The story's Tasks table explicitly assigns those pieces to BP-PERIOD-POLICY and BP-ASK-WIRING, so this is deferred P2 advice rather than a blocker for BP-ACTUAL-MONTHS.
